name: ansvar-compliance-skills
description: Marketplace for the Ansvar Compliance Skills plugin — twenty EU security and compliance skills (threat modeling, incident reporting, CRA, ISO standards, and the Ansvar workflow skill library), grounded via the Ansvar Gateway MCP connector. Also includes the focused Ansvar Vulnerability Management, Zero Trust and CMMC Self-Assessment plugins.

plugins.name: ansvar-compliance-skills
plugins.description: Twenty compliance skills for EU security work: four standalone skills (STRIDE/LINDDUN regulatory threat modeling, incident-reporting navigation across NIS2/GDPR/DORA/CRA, CRA vulnerability obligations, and the iso-standards-expert skill) plus the Ansvar workflow skill library (using-ansvar, gap analysis, threat modelling, DPIA/FRIA, TARA, tender review, vulnerability decisions, tabletop, document review, drone SORA, product applicability register, vulnerability management, zero trust assessment, CMMC base, Level 1 and Level 2 self-assessments; sixteen library skills) — every claim cited from officially published or licensed text via the Ansvar Gateway MCP connector (free plan available, business sign-up).

plugins.name: ansvar-vulnerability-management
plugins.description: Assess a vulnerability management programme and run a defensive vulnerability feed cycle with candidate findings, exposure questions, national advisories and one cursor across all feeds. Includes using-ansvar for cited legal and standards questions.

plugins.name: ansvar-zero-trust
plugins.description: Assess zero trust maturity against CISA ZTMM v2.0 with fetched guidance, interview or twin evidence, a gap register and a roadmap for the next cycle. Includes using-ansvar for cited legal and standards questions.

plugins.name: ansvar-cmmc
plugins.description: Run CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 self-assessments under 32 CFR Part 170 with cited NIST SP 800-171 requirements and objectives, human-attested evidence, the engine's result and status, the POA&M Level 2 allows, SPRS inputs and the affirmation. A self-assessment aid, not a C3PAO assessment or legal advice. Includes using-ansvar for cited legal and standards questions. Try: 'Using Ansvar, run a CMMC Level 1 self-assessment for our company.'
